ProductEditor.badgesInDeals: This phone is in Great Deals: set its deal badge in Great Deals.

Models.title: Models
Models.description: The phone spec database: specs, colours and storage options for every model. Products (the phones in stock) each belong to one model.
Models.bannerText: and {incomplete} are incomplete. Before a model goes on sale, compare its specs with the manufacturer’s page. Editing models here comes later: for now, fixes go in data/models.json.
Models.caption: Models
Models.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, series or chip…

Deals.title: Great Deals
Deals.description: Choose the phones in the homepage’s Great Deals, put them in order and add a promo badge. The first {max} in stock are shown; sold-out phones are skipped automatically.
Deals.preview: Live preview · homepage Great Deals ({count} shown)
Deals.previewEmpty: No phone in stock is selected: the section is hidden on the homepage.
Deals.listTitle: On the homepage, in this order
Deals.listEmpty: No phone yet. Add some from the list.

Packages.title: Packages
Packages.description: Price and contents of the “More than just a phone” packages. Contents marked “to be confirmed” show a TODO tag on the shop.
Packages.includedHint: French is required; English and Italian use the French text when left empty. The name and tagline are in messages/*.json.

Gauge.title: The Gauge
Gauge.description: Each purchase gives the customer a ticket; when the Gauge reaches 100% the prizes are drawn. The homepage shows the percentage below.
Gauge.show: Show the Gauge on the homepage
Gauge.fillHint: What customers see on the homepage.
Gauge.rulesNote: The official rules page is {path}. Its text lives in messages/*.json until the rules are final.
Gauge.hidden: The Gauge section is hidden on the homepage.

Orders.title: Orders
Orders.description: Every sale, in store or online, newest first. Open an order to see its payment and act on it.
Orders.placeholderText: Orders NC-2026-0101 to NC-2026-0118 are examples from data/orders.json. Orders placed through the shop’s checkout are real and appear next to them.
Orders.caption: Orders
Orders.searchPlaceholder: Search by order number, customer or phone…

OrderDetail.title: Order {number}
OrderDetail.explainAuthorised: The customer’s card is authorised for {amount} but not charged. Check with your suppliers, then decide: “Available” charges the card, “Not available” cancels the authorisation so the customer pays nothing.
OrderDetail.explainOnRequest: “On request” order: the customer paid nothing. Check with your suppliers, then decide. Either way, contact the customer to agree on the next step.
OrderDetail.authorisedOn: Authorised on {date}. Decide before about {deadline}: after that the bank drops the authorisation and the customer would have to pay again.
OrderDetail.name: Name
OrderDetail.confirmCharge: Charge {amount} to the customer’s card and confirm the order?
OrderDetail.confirmOnRequest: Confirm that it’s available? The customer is told to come and pay in the shop.
OrderDetail.declineCharged: The card authorisation is cancelled: the customer pays nothing.
OrderDetail.offerLabel: What you offer instead (shown to the customer)
OrderDetail.offerHint: Write it in the customer’s language: {language}.
